channel.title: Rise of the Guardians
channel.desc: The Guardians are Santa Claus, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy and the Sandman. Their job, as well as bringing happiness to children around the world, is to protect them. When the evil spirit Pitch comes to Earth, bringing an army of nightmares with him, the Guardians spring into action to protect the children while they sleep. But Pitch is powerful, and they need help from a reluctant new team member: the impish spirit of winter, Jack Frost. Featuring the voices of Chris Pine (Jack Frost), Alec Baldwin (North), Jude Law (Pitch), Isla Fisher (Tooth), Hugh Jackman (Bunny) and Dakota Goyo (Jamie Bennett).
